description:
Cast Burning Inquiry by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve Burning Inquiry, causing each player to draw three cards and discard three cards at random.
Cast Burning Inquiry from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {R} and exiling 3 cards from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
